features: SCREEN SIZE: Enjoy a comfortable 21.5-inch (54.6 cm) display that offers ample screen space for work, online classes, entertainment, and daily productivity without overwhelming your desk.
ASPECT RATIO: The standard 16:9 widescreen format delivers a natural viewing experience, making it perfect for movies, spreadsheets, presentations, and multitasking.
DISPLAY DESIGN: An anti-glare screen reduces reflections and eye strain, while the ultra-slim bezel-less design gives a modern look and maximizes the visible screen area.
COLOR SUPPORT: With support for 16.7 million colors, the display produces richer tones and smoother gradients, helping images and videos look more vibrant and lifelike.
INPUT CONNECTIVITY: Dual HDMI and VGA inputs allow quick and easy connection to desktops, laptops, and other devices, making switching between systems hassle-free.
RESOLUTION: Full HD (1920×1080) resolution ensures crisp text, sharp images, and clear visuals, improving comfort during long work hours and media viewing.
REFRESH RATE: The smooth 100Hz refresh rate reduces screen flicker and motion blur, offering fluid scrolling and a better responsive viewing experience.
WALL MOUNT SUPPORT: Supports 75 × 75 mm wall mounting, helping you save desk space and create a clean, organized setup at home or in the office.
